gen-luckiest-guy-gf-alexandria: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy looks poured from a single width of ink, while Alexandria, a tall-bodied plain sans, keeps generous terminals. Round-tipped pen letters against a low body make the sharpest difference here.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-amiko: A single unbroken line weight gives Luckiest Guy its loud, cheerful punch, while Amiko stays a modern plain sans. Amiko's outward-pointing terminals keep the loud heading company without competing.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-anek-gujarati: Luckiest Guy brings a loud, cheerful display voice with a y whose tail matches its arm, over Anek Gujarati. The sans partner's lowercase rivals its capitals, which keeps things approachable.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono has clipped ascenders and capitals, spacing stretched wide like stencil bridges, and counters that breathe into the white space. Luckiest Guy earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-biryani: Biryani gives every e a clear, large eye and draws with no modulation, so its small counters never clog. Luckiest Guy is happiest at large sizes, with its cheerful loudness given room.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-blinker: Loud, cheerful and poured-ink thick, Luckiest Guy grabs the eye first. Blinker then settles in as a sans whose open apertures and full-height lowercase keep paragraphs flowing smoothly from line to line.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic: Luckiest Guy hits with a flat, stencil-cut feel, every stroke a single weight, loud and cheerful in equal measure. Carrois Gothic sits low, a sans-serif with a generous opening in c.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: A loud, cheerful shout in a single line weight: that is Luckiest Guy. Carrois Gothic SC, a sans-serif with clear curve endings and little gap between capital and lowercase height, keeps the shouting company.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-chivo: Loud, cheerful and neon-tube bright, Luckiest Guy glows with one steady line thickness from end to end. And if Luckiest Guy goes small the punch drains, while Chivo keeps daylight through every curve.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-geist: Loud, cheerful and poured thick, with a mean line set high: Luckiest Guy. Geist keeps a level beat and solid word blocks, quiet plain sans next to all that noise.
